Best regards,

Admissions Team, Northbridge College London

question: How do I apply for the Foundation Year in Business, and how long until I hear back?

Dear Student,

Thank you for your interest in the Foundation Year in Business at Northbridge College London. 

To apply, please follow these steps:
1. Complete the online application form on our college website.
2. Upload copies of your qualification certificates and photo ID. (If you are an international student, please also upload your passport and English test results). 
3. Please note that Foundation Year applicants applying with work experience instead of UCAS points may be required to attend a short interview.

The admissions team reviews applications within 10 working days, and you can also check your application status at any time by logging in to the applicant portal. If anything requires a staff decision, a member of the admissions team will follow up with you.

Best regards,

Admissions Team, Northbridge College London
